name: Lügde (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over red, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Lügde (a red cross and rose on white beside a key on blue).
history: The flag is blue and red striped lengthwise with the city shield shifted from the centre towards the staff; the banner carries the shield above the centre.

features.role: Lügde arms — cross, rose and key
